This test checks that the quick fix for "undeclared: f" that declares
the missing function fails gracefully when an argument is a composite
literal with no type, whose type cannot be inferred (go1.28).
See go.dev/issue/82039.

-- flags --
-min_go=go1.28
-ignore_extra_diags

-- go.mod --
module mod.com

go 1.28

-- a.go --
package a

func _() { f({1, 2}) } //@quickfixerr(re"f.{", re"unde(fined|clared name): f", re"unable to determine type for argument {1, 2}")
